# AI Voice Agent Receptionist

> AI voice agent receptionist for UK businesses. Answers every call 24/7 in a
> natural voice, qualifies leads, books appointments and texts a summary. A
> service of Antek Automation, a Certified Retell AI Partner.

## Summary

An AI voice agent receptionist is a phone system that answers your business
calls in a natural voice, handles enquiries, qualifies leads, books
appointments into your calendar and hands off to a human when needed — 24/7,
with a written summary of every call. Serving businesses across the UK.

- Voice agents: from £97/month plus £249 setup.
- Chatbots: from £57/month plus £149 setup.
- No long-term contracts. Most setups go live within 24–48 hours.
- Phone: 0333 038 9960. Email: hello@antekautomation.com.

## Industries served

Plumbers, electricians, HVAC, dentists, lawyers / law firms, accountants,
therapists, veterinary practices, and any other phone-based business in the UK.
